page_title: BRE 2-0 SHU | Brentford v Sheffield Utd 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Samuel Barrott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' 2 - 0 Frank Onyeka (Brentford) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the right post. What a lovely finish!
90+1' Substitution. Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) has come on for Mason Holgate.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Jensen departs the field of play to be replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) replaces Yoane Wissa.

90' A cross by Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kevin Schade (Brentford) is coming onto the pitch as Bryan Mbeumo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' The yellow card is received by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
88' Brentford take a short corner kick.
87' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

86' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Ivo Grbic thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
85' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and signals a foul after Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Sheffield Utd.
79' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Neal Maupay and he is replaced by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mikkel Damsgaard walks off the pitch to be replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
78' The corner is swung in but Sheffield Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' A corner kick by Sheffield Utd is thwarted by the well prepared Mark Flekken (Brentford). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sheffield Utd.
76' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) replacing Jayden Bogle.
75' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

75' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd win a corner kick.
72' Celebrations are cut short for Brentford as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
70' The Brentford players halt their celebrations as referee Samuel Barrott makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
68' Bryan Mbeumo floats a lovely ball in from the free kick to Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford), and he strikes the ball inside the left post to increase the score to 2:0.
68' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
68' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Samuel Barrott saw the whole situation. Brentford are awarded a free kick.
66' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Sheffield Utd was in an offside position.
63' 1 - 0 What bad luck! Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 1:0.
61' Sheffield Utd fail to score from a corner as Mark Flekken (Brentford) leaps to collect the ball.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sheffield Utd. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sheffield Utd.
60' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivo Grbic intercepts the ball.
57' Substitution. James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) replaces Yasser Larouci.
57' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) makes a strong challenge and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. Free kick. Brentford will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
55' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Zanka (Brentford) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
55' Brentford have been awarded a free kick.
55' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle after Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brentford.
53' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
53' One of the players from Brentford times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
47' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivo Grbic, who smothers the ball.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Neal Maupay (Brentford) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The referee shows the yellow card to Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd).
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sheffield Utd comes to nothing.
41' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Vitaly Janelt (Brentford), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
40' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Ivo Grbic makes a comfortable save.
38' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Yoane Wissa (Brentford) heads on.
38' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

37' Neal Maupay (Brentford) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Ivo Grbic. The referee points to the corner flag and Brentford will take a corner.
34' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.

34' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick is awarded to Brentford.
33' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.

32' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Brentford, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

31' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Ivo Grbic was alert and the score remains the same.

27' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
26' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

23' A precise low pass is received by Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.

22' What a sweet touch by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
17' Brentford will take a free kick near the side line. Samuel Barrott interrupts the game. One of the players from Sheffield Utd won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
15' The foul by Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) was seen by Samuel Barrott who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

13' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
12' The free kick is taken short by Brentford.
11' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Brentford get a free kick.
9' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
7' Neal Maupay (Brentford) sees a yellow card from Samuel Barrott after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
7' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
6' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) plays a through ball but overhits it.
5' Sheffield Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

5' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Good work from Sheffield Utd as they win a corner.
4' It's a free kick to Sheffield Utd in a dangerous position. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
3' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mark Flekken comes off the line to clear the ball away.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Sheffield Utd will take the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
